description.en: Condom provides the section names for Electric 20 delivery pipe 80 mm. Electric 20 Concrete Pump is an electric trailer pump made in Xingtai. Its delivery-pipe inner diameter cell is 80 mm. Ask for the straight pipe only with this model, 80 mm, a length and a quantity. Wall thickness is not printed.
description.zh: 《Condom》为Electric 20 delivery pipe 80 mm提供章节名。电动20型混凝土泵是邢台制造的电动拖泵。它的输送管内径一格是 80 mm。询直管时带上这一型号、80 mm、长度和数量。壁厚没有印出。

h1.en: Electric 20 delivery pipe 80 mm restated in the order of Condom
h1.zh: 按《Condom》的次序重述Electric 20 delivery pipe 80 mm

directAnswer.en: Electric 20 delivery pipe 80 mm is restated below in Hebei Pinjin Machinery’s own catalogue words. The section order is the order of Condom, and that page is not a second nameplate. Electric 20 Concrete Pump is an electric trailer pump made in Xingtai. Its delivery-pipe inner diameter cell is 80 mm. Ask for the straight pipe only with this model, 80 mm, a length and a quantity. Wall thickness is not printed.
directAnswer.zh: Electric 20 delivery pipe 80 mm下面用河北品锦机械目录里已经有的说法重述。章节次序来自《Condom》，那一页不是第二块铭牌。 电动20型混凝土泵是邢台制造的电动拖泵。它的输送管内径一格是 80 mm。询直管时带上这一型号、80 mm、长度和数量。壁厚没有印出。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Medical uses”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. The published sheet says model Electric 20, motor 22 kW, output 8–10 m³/h, maximum outlet pressure 10 MPa, hopper 0.25 m³, pumping distance 120 m / 40 m, delivery pipe inner diameter 80 mm, maximum aggregate 1–2 cm, size 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm, weight 900 kg. The 120 m / 40 m cell is conveying distance. It is not a pipe length and it is not a wall thickness. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“医学用途”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 已公布参数：型号 Electric 20，电机 22 kW，输送量 8–10 m³/h，最大出口压力 10 MPa，料斗 0.25 m³，输送距离 120 m / 40 m，输送管内径 80 mm，最大骨料 1–2 cm，外形 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm，重量 900 kg。120 m / 40 m 是输送距离，不是管子长度，也不是壁厚。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The heading “Side effects” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. Order the spare from the Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe page. That page is a red straight pipe with reinforced coupling ends. It has no fixed diameter table and no wall thickness. Do not replace 80 mm with the 100 / 125 mm cell printed on Integrated Mixer Pump, HBT8018, HBT80-16 or LZ-60. Electric 15 uses a dash, 100–125 mm, which is also a different cell. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 标题“来源章节：Side effects”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 直管从混凝土泵输送管页询价。那一页是带加强快接端的红色直管，没有固定管径表，也没有壁厚。不要把 80 mm 换成搅拌泵一体机、HBT8018、HBT80-16 或 LZ-60 上的 100 / 125 mm。电动15用的是连接号 100–125 mm，也是另一格。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Use”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Send this model name, the inner diameter printed on its own page, the length you need, and the quantity. Do not send a wall thickness. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“使用”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写上这一型号、它自己页面上的内径、需要的长度和数量。不要填写壁厚。 标题到此为止。

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Types”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. Electric 20 Concrete Pump is an electric trailer pump made in Xingtai. Its delivery-pipe inner diameter cell is 80 mm. Ask for the straight pipe only with this model, 80 mm, a length and a quantity. Wall thickness is not printed. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 来源页在“类型”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 电动20型混凝土泵是邢台制造的电动拖泵。它的输送管内径一格是 80 mm。询直管时带上这一型号、80 mm、长度和数量。壁厚没有印出。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: “Prevalence” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. No. The spare page has no fixed size table. The figure comes from this model's specification cell. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: “来源章节：Prevalence”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 不是。直管页没有固定尺寸表。数字来自这一型号参数表上的格子。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: “History” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. No. A metre figure for horizontal or vertical conveying is distance, not a cut length for the spare. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “历史”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 不是。水平或垂直的米数是输送距离，不是配件的截取长度。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: “Society and culture” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. Neither is printed. Both are missing fields. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “来源章节：Society and culture”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 都没有印。两项都是缺字段。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Research”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Stop when the printed fragment stops. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Condom
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“研究”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Condom

question.en: Where does the photograph sit relative to the printed Electric 20 delivery pipe 80 mm cells?
question.zh: 这张配图相对Electric 20 delivery pipe 80 mm的已印格子处于什么位置？

answer.en: No. The spare page has no fixed size table. The figure comes from this model's specification cell. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。直管页没有固定尺寸表。数字来自这一型号参数表上的格子。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Which printed fragment stays in force when the section is “History” for Electric 20 delivery pipe 80 mm?
question.zh: 章节为“历史”时，Electric 20 delivery pipe 80 mm仍以哪一句已印文字为准？

answer.en: No. A metre figure for horizontal or vertical conveying is distance, not a cut length for the spare. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。水平或垂直的米数是输送距离，不是配件的截取长度。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
